verdict.rationale: LM Studio's homepage says Bionic transcribes speech in real time and that voice and audio data are processed locally and never leave the device. That covers dictation, real-time transcription and on-device processing, but only as a brief marketing claim. Missing for 10: in-depth docs (which transcription model, supported languages, accuracy, setup or controls), dictation outside the Bionic app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model

citations.quote: Talk to Bionic naturally, and your speech gets transcribed in real time. Your voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
